column1: # 🔵 THE FINDING IN THE PROBE ITSELF. Gap 532 said channel availability is tool-scoped. It holds in a
# sixth sandbox and now in BOTH directions at once: github.com is tool-scoped OPEN (WebFetch 200) and
# tool-scoped CLOSED (curl 403), while eur-lex is closed on BOTH tools by TWO DIFFERENT mechanisms —
# a proxy CONNECT refusal and a DNS failure. "Unreachable" is therefore not one state, and a pass that
# records a single verdict per host loses the distinction that tells it whether to try another tool.
